text: The project is a flagship element of Gisborne District Council's flood resilience portfolio, accelerating completion by four years to 2027. It includes significant engineering upgrades such as widening and raising stopbanks, installing floodgates, and rock armouring. The project is strategically aligned with national climate resilience goals and leverages government co-funding to expedite delivery.

metadata.solution_name: Waipaoa Flood Control Climate Change Resilience Project (WFCS Upgrade)
